23: /****************************************************************************
24:  * Pre-processor Definitions
25:  ****************************************************************************/
26: 
27: /* 默认显示分辨率 (4.3寸面板: 1024x600) */
28: 
29: #define D13X_FB_WIDTH           1024
30: #define D13X_FB_HEIGHT          600
31: #define D13X_FB_BPP             32      /* RGB888 */
32: #define D13X_FB_STRIDE          (D13X_FB_WIDTH * (D13X_FB_BPP / 8))
33: #define D13X_FB_SIZE            (D13X_FB_STRIDE * D13X_FB_HEIGHT)
34: 
35: /* 双缓冲 */
36: 
37: #define D13X_FB_BUFFER_COUNT    2
38: 
39: /* 像素时钟 (4.3寸面板: 1024x600@60Hz, 约51.2MHz) */
40: 
41: #define D13X_PIXEL_CLOCK        51200000
42: 
43: /****************************************************************************
44:  * Private Types
45:  ****************************************************************************/
46: 
47: struct d13x_fb_info_s
48: {
49:   bool                initialized;
50:   bool                power_on;
51:   void               *fb_mem;        /* 帧缓冲内存 */
52:   size_t              fb_size;       /* 单帧大小 */
53:   struct fb_vtable_s  vtable;        /* NuttX FB 接口 */
54: };
55: 
56: /****************************************************************************
57:  * Private Data
58:  ****************************************************************************/
59: 
60: static struct d13x_fb_info_s g_d13x_fb;
61: 
62: /****************************************************************************
63:  * Private Functions
64:  ****************************************************************************/
65: 
66: static int d13x_fb_getvideoinfo(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
67:                                 struct fb_videoinfo_s *vinfo)
68: {
69:   if (!vtable || !vinfo)
70:     {
71:       return -EINVAL;
72:     }
73: 
74:   vinfo->fmt = FB_FMT_RGB32;     /* RGB888 */
75:   vinfo->nplanes = 1;
76:   vinfo->xres = D13X_FB_WIDTH;
77:   vinfo->yres = D13X_FB_HEIGHT;
78: 
79:   iinfo("getvideoinfo: %dx%d RGB888\n", D13X_FB_WIDTH, D13X_FB_HEIGHT);
80:   return OK;
81: }
82: 
83: static int d13x_fb_getplaneinfo(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int planeno,
84:                                 struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
85: {
86:   struct d13x_fb_info_s *fbi = &g_d13x_fb;
87: 
88:   if (!vtable || planeno != 0 || !pinfo)
89:     {
90:       return -EINVAL;
91:     }
92: 
93:   pinfo->bpp = D13X_FB_BPP;
94:   pinfo->display = 0;
95:   pinfo->stride = D13X_FB_STRIDE;
96:   pinfo->fblen = fbi->fb_size * D13X_FB_BUFFER_COUNT;
97:   pinfo->fbmem = fbi->fb_mem;
98:   pinfo->xres_virtual = D13X_FB_WIDTH;
99:   pinfo->yres_virtual = D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFER_COUNT;
100: 
101:   iinfo("getplaneinfo: %d bpp, stride=%d, fblen=%d\n",
102:         D13X_FB_BPP, D13X_FB_STRIDE, pinfo->fblen);
103:   return OK;
104: }
105: 
106: static int d13x_fb_setpower(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int power)
107: {
108:   struct d13x_fb_info_s *fbi = &g_d13x_fb;
109: 
110:   if (!vtable)
111:     {
112:       return -EINVAL;
113:     }
114: 
115:   fbi->power_on = (power > 0);
116:   iinfo("setpower: %s\n", fbi->power_on ? "ON" : "OFF");
117:   return OK;
118: }
119: 
120: static int d13x_fb_getpower(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable)
121: {
122:   struct d13x_fb_info_s *fbi = &g_d13x_fb;
123: 
124:   if (!vtable)
125:     {
126:       return -EINVAL;
127:     }
128: 
129:   return fbi->power_on ? 1 : 0;
130: }
131: 
132: static int d13x_fb_pandisplay(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
133:                               struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
134: {
135:   struct d13x_fb_info_s *fbi = &g_d13x_fb;
136:   void *fb_addr;
137: 
138:   if (!vtable || !pinfo || !fbi->initialized)
139:     {
140:       return -EINVAL;
141:     }
142: 
143:   /* 根据 yoffset 计算帧缓冲地址 */
144: 
145:   fb_addr = (void *)((uint32_t)fbi->fb_mem + pinfo->yoffset * D13X_FB_STRIDE);
146: 
147:   iinfo("pandisplay: yoffset=%d, addr=0x%08x\n", pinfo->yoffset, (uint32_t)fb_addr);
148: 
149: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_DISPLAY
150:   /* 更新显示引擎帧缓冲地址 */
151: 
152:   d13x_de_set_framebuffer((uint32_t)fb_addr);
153: #endif
154: 
155:   return OK;
156: }

159:  * Public Functions
160:  ****************************************************************************/
161: 
162: /****************************************************************************
163:  * Name: up_fbinitialize
164:  *
165:  * Description:
166:  *   初始化 D13x 帧缓冲硬件
167:  *
168:  ****************************************************************************/
169: 
170: int up_fbinitialize(int display)
171: {
172:   struct d13x_fb_info_s *fbi = &g_d13x_fb;
173:   void *fb_mem;
174:   size_t fb_size;
175: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_DISPLAY
176:   int ret;
177: #endif
178: 
179:   if (fbi->initialized)
180:     {
181:       return OK;
182:     }
183: 
184:   iinfo("Initializing D13x framebuffer...\n");
185: 
186:   /* 分配帧缓冲内存 (双缓冲) */
187: 
188:   fb_size = D13X_FB_SIZE * D13X_FB_BUFFER_COUNT;
189:   fb_mem = kmm_memalign(64, fb_size);  /* 64字节对齐 (cache line) */
190:   if (!fb_mem)
191:     {
192:       ierr("Failed to allocate framebuffer memory (%d bytes)\n", fb_size);
193:       return -ENOMEM;
194:     }
195: 
196:   /* 清零帧缓冲 */
197: 
198:   memset(fb_mem, 0, fb_size);
199: 
200:   /* 初始化 fb_info */
201: 
202:   fbi->fb_mem = fb_mem;
203:   fbi->fb_size = D13X_FB_SIZE;
204:   fbi->power_on = false;
205: 
206:   /* 设置 fb_vtable_s 接口 */
207: 
208:   memset(&fbi->vtable, 0, sizeof(fbi->vtable));
209:   fbi->vtable.getvideoinfo = d13x_fb_getvideoinfo;
210:   fbi->vtable.getplaneinfo = d13x_fb_getplaneinfo;
211:   fbi->vtable.setpower = d13x_fb_setpower;
212:   fbi->vtable.getpower = d13x_fb_getpower;
213:   fbi->vtable.pandisplay = d13x_fb_pandisplay;
214: 
215:   fbi->initialized = true;
216: 
217:   iinfo("D13x framebuffer initialized: %dx%d, %d bpp, %d bytes\n",
218:         D13X_FB_WIDTH, D13X_FB_HEIGHT, D13X_FB_BPP, fb_size);
219: 
220: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_DISPLAY
221:   /* 初始化 MIPI DSI 控制器 */
222: 
223:   ret = d13x_dsi_init(D13X_PIXEL_CLOCK);
224:   if (ret < 0)
225:     {
226:       ierr("MIPI DSI init failed: %d\n", ret);
227:       goto err_with_fbmem;
228:     }
229: 
230:   /* 初始化 LCD 面板 */
231: 
232:   ret = d13x_panel_init();
233:   if (ret < 0)
234:     {
235:       ierr("LCD panel init failed: %d\n", ret);
236:       goto err_with_fbmem;
237:     }
238: 
239:   /* 初始化显示引擎 */
240: 
241:   ret = d13x_de_init(D13X_FB_WIDTH, D13X_FB_HEIGHT);
242:   if (ret < 0)
243:     {
244:       ierr("Display Engine init failed: %d\n", ret);
245:       goto err_with_fbmem;
246:     }
247: 
248:   d13x_de_set_framebuffer((uint32_t)fb_mem);
249:   d13x_de_enable();
250:   d13x_panel_enable();
251: #endif
252: 
253:   return OK;
254: 
255: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_DISPLAY
256: err_with_fbmem:
257:   kmm_free(fb_mem);
258:   fbi->fb_mem = NULL;
259:   fbi->initialized = false;
260:   return -EIO;
261: #endif
262: }

2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/driver-troubleshooting-guide.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: 本文档旨在为 `openvela`  驱动开发者提供一份常见问题排查指南与最佳实践。驱动开发不仅要求开发者精通硬件，还需深入理解操作系统（Operating System, OS）的运行机制。许多开发者在适配新驱动时，常在初始化时序、API 调用、内存管理、并发控制等方面遇到问题。
6: 
7: 本指南将系统性地阐述这些典型问题，并提供经过验证的解决方案，以提升开发效率和代码质量。
8: 
9: ## 一、驱动初始化：确保时序与依赖正确
10: 
11: 正确的初始化是驱动稳定运行的基石。驱动的初始化逻辑必须严格遵守系统的启动顺序和资源依赖关系，否则将引发一系列难以预料的问题。
12: 
13: ### 1、依赖文件系统的操作应延迟初始化
14: 
15: - **问题现象**：在驱动初始化阶段调用文件操作接口（如 `open()`, `read()`）失败。
16: 
17: - **原因分析**：文件操作依赖于文件系统的成功挂载。在 `openvela` 的启动流程中，核心驱动和系统服务有明确的初始化顺序。如果驱动初始化过早，文件系统尚未就绪，相关调用便会失败。
18: 
19: - **解决方案**：您应将依赖文件系统的驱动初始化逻辑，迁移到系统启动后期执行的 `board_app_finalinitialize()` 函数中。此函数在所有核心系统服务（包括文件系统）初始化完成后被调用，确保了依赖项的可用性。
20: 
21: - **相关文档**：[系统启动流程](../kernel/boot_process.md)
22: 
23: ### 2、依赖远程节点的操作需等待通信就绪
24: 
25: - **问题症状**：在驱动中与远程处理核心（如另一颗芯片）通信失败。
26: 
27: - **原因分析**：跨芯片通信依赖于远端系统的完全启动以及消息通信组件（如 `rpmsg`）的初始化完成。过早地尝试通信会导致失败。
28: 
29: - **解决方案**：您必须将此类驱动的初始化或通信逻辑延后执行。您可以通过信号量或事件标志等同步机制，等待远端系统和本地 `rpmsg` 设备就绪的信号，再执行相关操作。
30: 
31: ### 3、依赖 KVDB 服务的操作需在其启动后执行
32: 
33: - **问题症状**：在驱动中操作键值数据库（Key-Value Database, KVDB）导致系统挂起或服务不可用。
34: 
35: - **原因分析**：KVDB 作为一项系统级服务，通常由系统初始化脚本（如 `rc.sysinit`）启动。在它完成初始化之前，任何对它的调用都将失败或阻塞。
36: 
37: - **解决方案**：将依赖 KVDB 的驱动初始化逻辑或相关功能调用，同样放置在 `board_app_finalinitialize()` 函数中，或在确认 `kvdb` 服务已运行后执行。
38: 
39: ### 4、避免在初始化函数中执行耗时操作
40: 
41: - **问题症状**：系统整体启动时间显著变长。
42: 
43: - **原因分析**：驱动的初始化函数在系统启动路径上同步执行，任何耗时的操作（如硬件轮询等待、长延时 `sleep`）都会直接阻塞后续流程，从而延长总开机时间。
44: 
45: - **解决方案**：
46: 
47:     1. **移除不必要的延时**：审查代码，移除所有非必需的延时调用。
48:     2. **使用异步工作队列**：如果必须执行耗时操作，您应将其提交到工作队列（Work Queue）中异步执行。这允许初始化函数快速返回，而不会阻塞系统启动。
49: 
50: - **相关文档**：[工作队列开发指南](../kernel/IPC/work_queue.md)

# 常见问题与最佳实践

\[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/driver-troubleshooting-guide.md) | 简体中文 \]

本文档旨在为 `openvela`  驱动开发者提供一份常见问题排查指南与最佳实践。驱动开发不仅要求开发者精通硬件，还需深入理解操作系统（Operating System, OS）的运行机制。许多开发者在适配新驱动时，常在初始化时序、API 调用、内存管理、并发控制等方面遇到问题。

本指南将系统性地阐述这些典型问题，并提供经过验证的解决方案，以提升开发效率和代码质量。

## 一、驱动初始化：确保时序与依赖正确

正确的初始化是驱动稳定运行的基石。驱动的初始化逻辑必须严格遵守系统的启动顺序和资源依赖关系，否则将引发一系列难以预料的问题。

### 1、依赖文件系统的操作应延迟初始化

- **问题现象**：在驱动初始化阶段调用文件操作接口（如 `open()`, `read()`）失败。

- **原因分析**：文件操作依赖于文件系统的成功挂载。在 `openvela` 的启动流程中，核心驱动和系统服务有明确的初始化顺序。如果驱动初始化过早，文件系统尚未就绪，相关调用便会失败。

- **解决方案**：您应将依赖文件系统的驱动初始化逻辑，迁移到系统启动后期执行的 `board_app_finalinitialize()` 函数中。此函数在所有核心系统服务（包括文件系统）初始化完成后被调用，确保了依赖项的可用性。

242:             {
243:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
244:             }
245: 
246:           up_udelay(1);
247:         }
248: 
249:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
250:     }
251: 
252:   /* 等待传输完成 */
253: 
254:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
255:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
256:     {
257:       if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
258:         {
259:           dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
260:           return -EIO;
261:         }
262: 
263:       if (--timeout == 0)
264:         {
265:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
266:         }
267: 
268:       up_udelay(1);
269:     }
270: 
271:   /* 清除中断标志 */
272: 
273:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
274: 
275:   return msg->length;
276: }
277: 
278: static int dw_i2c_xfer_read(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
279:                             struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
280: {
281:   uint32_t timeout;
282:   int i;
283:   int rx_cnt = 0;
284: 
285:   /* 设置目标地址 */
286: 
287:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
288: 
289:   /* 发送读命令 */
290: 
291:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
292:     {
293:       uint32_t cmd = DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_READ;
294: 
295:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
296: 
297:       if (i == msg->length - 1)
298:         {
299:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
300:         }
301: 
302:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
303:     }
304: 
305:   /* 读取数据 */
306: 
307:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
308:     {
309:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
310: 
311:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_RXFLR) == 0)
312:         {
313:           if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
314:             {
315:               dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
316:               return -EIO;
317:             }
318: 
319:           if (--timeout == 0)
320:             {
321:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
322:             }
323: 
324:           up_udelay(1);
325:         }
326: 
327:       msg->buffer[i] = (uint8_t)(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xFF);
328:       rx_cnt++;
329:     }
330: 
331:   /* 等待 STOP 检测 */
332: 
333:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
334:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
335:     {
336:       if (--timeout == 0)
337:         {
338:           break;
339:         }
340: 
341:       up_udelay(1);
342:     }
343: 
344:   /* 清除中断标志 */
345: 
346:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
347: 
348:   return rx_cnt;
349: }

359: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
360:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count)
361: {
362:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv = (struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *)dev;
363:   int ret = 0;
364:   int i;
365: 
366:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
367: 
368:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
369:     {
370:       struct i2c_msg_s *msg = &msgs[i];
371: 
372:       if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
373:         {
374:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_read(priv, msg);
375:         }
376:       else
377:         {
378:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_write(priv, msg);
379:         }
380: 
381:       if (ret < 0)
382:         {
383:           ierr("I2C 传输失败: %d\n", ret);
384:           break;
385:         }
386:     }
387: 
388:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
389:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : count;
390: }

445:  *

447: 
448: struct i2c_master_s *d13x_i2cbus_initialize(int bus)
449: {
450:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv;
451:   uint32_t reg;
452: 
453:   switch (bus)
454:     {
455: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
456:       case 0:
457:         priv = &g_i2c0_priv;
458:         break;
459: #endif
460: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
461:       case 1:
462:         priv = &g_i2c1_priv;
463:         break;
464: #endif
465: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
466:       case 2:
467:         priv = &g_i2c2_priv;
468:         break;
469: #endif
470:       default:
471:         return NULL;
472:     }
473: 
474:   /* 使能 I2C 模块时钟 */
475: 
476:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
477:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
478:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
479: 
480:   /* 禁用 I2C 以配置 */
481: 
482:   dw_i2c_disable(priv);
483: 
484:   /* 配置为主模式, Fast Mode (400kHz), 重启使能 */
485: 
486:   reg = DW_I2C_CTL_MASTER | DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS | DW_I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
487:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_CTL, reg);
488: 
489:   /* 配置 SCL 时序 (400kHz @ I2C模块时钟)
490:    * 根据 luban-lite HAL, I2C模块时钟为24MHz (I2C_DEFALT_CLOCK)
491:    * FS_SCL_HCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 8 = 22
492:    * FS_SCL_LCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 1 = 29
493:    */
494: 
495:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, 22);
496:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, 29);
497: 
498:   /* 设置 SDA 保持时间 */
499: 
500:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD, 12);
501: 
502:   /* 设置 TX/RX FIFO 阈值 */
503: 
504:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xFFFF);
505:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_MASK, 0);
506: 
507:   /* 使能 I2C */
508: 
509:   dw_i2c_enable(priv);
510: 
511:   /* 初始化互斥锁 */
512: 
513:   nxmutex_init(&priv->lock);
514: 
515:   iinfo("I2C%d 初始化完成, 基地址=0x%08X\n", bus, priv->base);
516: 
517:   return &priv->dev;
518: }

72:     void *TST1 = base + DSI_PHY_TEST1;
73:     void *TST2 = base + DSI_PHY_TEST2;
74: 
75:     reg_set_bit(TST2, DSI_PHY_TEST2_EN);
76:     aic_udelay(1);
77:     reg_set_bit(TST1, DSI_PHY_TEST1_CLK);
78:     aic_udelay(1);
79:     reg_set_bits(TST2, DSI_PHY_TEST2_DIN_MASK, DSI_PHY_TEST2_DIN(code));
80:     aic_udelay(1);
81:     reg_clr_bit(TST1, DSI_PHY_TEST1_CLK);
82:     aic_udelay(1);
83:     reg_clr_bit(TST2, DSI_PHY_TEST2_EN);
84:     aic_udelay(1);
85: 
86:     if (p_wdata && p_rdata) {
87:         u32 *pi = p_wdata;
88:         u32 *po = p_rdata;
89: 
90:         reg_set_bits(TST2, DSI_PHY_TEST2_DIN_MASK,
91:                 DSI_PHY_TEST2_DIN(*pi++));
92:         aic_udelay(1);
93:         reg_set_bit(TST1, DSI_PHY_TEST1_CLK);
94:         aic_udelay(1);
95:         *po++ = reg_rd_bits(TST2,
96:             DSI_PHY_TEST2_DOUT_MASK, DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME_SHIFT);
97:         aic_udelay(1);
98:         reg_clr_bit(TST1, DSI_PHY_TEST1_CLK);
99:         aic_udelay(1);
100:     }
101: }

234: void dsi_phy_init(void *base, ulong mclk, u32 lane)
235: {
236:     void *ANA2 = base + DSI_ANA_CFG2;
237:     void *CFG = base + DSI_PHY_CFG;
238:     void *TST1 = base + DSI_PHY_TEST1;
239:     int ret;
240:     u32 val;
241: 
242:     reg_write(base + DSI_PHY_RD_TIME, 50);
243: 
244:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME,
245:         DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME_HS2LP_MASK | DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME_LP2HS_MASK,
246:         DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME_HS2LP(20) | DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME_LP2HS(20));
247:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME,
248:         DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME_HS2LP_MASK | DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME_LP2HS_MASK,
249:         DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME_HS2LP(20) | DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME_LP2HS(20));
250: 
251:     reg_set_bit(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_BIAS);
252:     aic_udelay(5);
253:     reg_set_bits(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP_MASK, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP(3));
254:     reg_set_bits(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO_MASK,
255:             DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO(0x1F));
256:     aic_udelay(10);
257:     reg_set_bit(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_RESCAL);
258:     reg_set_bit(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_ON_RESCAL);
259:     ret = readl_poll_timeout(ANA2, val, val & DSI_ANA_CFG2_RCAL_FLAG,
260:             DSI_TIMEOUT_US);
261:     if (ret) {
262:         pr_err("Timeout during wait rcal flag\n");
263:         return;
264:     }
265: 
266:     reg_set_bit(ANA2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_CLK);
267:     reg_set_bit(TST1, DSI_PHY_TEST1_CLR);
268:     aic_udelay(5);
269:     reg_clr_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN);
270:     aic_udelay(5);
271:     reg_clr_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ);
272:     aic_udelay(5);
273:     reg_clr_bit(TST1, DSI_PHY_TEST1_CLR);
274:     aic_udelay(5);
275: 
276:     dsi_dphy_cfg_hsfreq(base, mclk);
277:     dsi_dphy_cfg(base, 0, NULL, NULL);
278:     reg_set_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ);
279:     aic_udelay(5);
280:     reg_set_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN);
281:     aic_udelay(5);
282:     reg_set_bits(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME_MASK,
283:         DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME(10));
284:     reg_set_bits(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE_MASK,
285:         DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE(lane - 1));
286:     aic_udelay(5);
287:     reg_set_bit(CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_CLK_EN);
288: }

316: void dsi_set_vm(void *base, enum dsi_mode mode, enum dsi_format format,
317:         u32 lane, u32 vc, const struct display_timing *timing)
318: {
319:     void *IFCFG = base + DSI_DPI_IF_CFG;
320:     void *INFMT = base + DSI_DPI_IN_FMT;
321:     void *INPOL = base + DSI_DPI_IN_POL;
322:     void *CMDCFG = base + DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG;
323:     void *VIDCFG = base + DSI_VID_MODE_CFG;
324:     u32 if_cfg_fmt[] = {0, 0, 1, 2};
325:     u32 in_fmt_dt[] = {5, 3, 3, 1};
326:     u32 dsi_bits_per_pixel[] = {24, 24, 18, 16};
327:     u32 ht = timing->hback_porch + timing->hsync_len + timing->hactive +
328:         timing->hfront_porch;
329: 
330:     if (unlikely(format >= DSI_FMT_MAX))
331:         BUG();
332:     if (unlikely(mode >= DSI_MOD_MAX))
333:         BUG();
334: 
335:     reg_clr_bit(IFCFG, DSI_DPI_IF_CFG_SHUTD);
336:     reg_clr_bit(IFCFG, DSI_DPI_IF_CFG_COLORM);
337:     reg_set_bits(IFCFG, DSI_DPI_IF_CFG_FMT_MASK,
338:         DSI_DPI_IF_CFG_FMT(if_cfg_fmt[format]));
339:     reg_set_bits(INFMT, DSI_DPI_IN_FMT_DT_MASK,
340:         DSI_DPI_IN_FMT_DT(in_fmt_dt[format]));
341:     if (format == DSI_FMT_RGB666L)
342:         reg_set_bit(INFMT, DSI_DPI_IN_FMT_LOOSELY18);
343:     else
344:         reg_clr_bit(INFMT, DSI_DPI_IN_FMT_LOOSELY18);
345: 
346:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_DPI_VC, DSI_DPI_VC_NUM_MASK,
347:             DSI_DPI_VC_NUM(vc));
348:     reg_clr_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_DE);
349:     reg_set_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_VSYNC);
350:     reg_set_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_HSYNC);
351:     reg_clr_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_SHUTDOWN);
352:     reg_clr_bit(INPOL, DSI_DPI_IN_POL_COLORM);
353: 
354:     if (mode == DSI_MOD_CMD_MODE) {
355:         reg_set_bit(base + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_DSI_MODE);
356:         reg_write(base + DSI_EDPI_CMD_SIZE, timing->hactive);
357:         reg_clr_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_ACK_REQ_EN);
358:         reg_clr_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_TE_EN);
359:         reg_clr_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_LW);
360:         return;
361:     }
362: 
363:     reg_clr_bit(base + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_DSI_MODE);
364:     reg_set_bits(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_TYPE_MASK,
365:             DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_TYPE(mode));
366:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_VSA);
367:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_VBP);
368:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_VFP);
369:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_VACT);
370:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_HBP);
371:     if (mode == DSI_MOD_VID_BURST)
372:         reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_HFP);
373:     else
374:         reg_clr_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_LP_EN_HFP);
375:     reg_clr_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_FRAME_BTA_ACK_EN);
376:     reg_set_bit(VIDCFG, DSI_VID_MODE_CFG_CMD_LPTX_FORCE);
377: 
378:     reg_write(base + DSI_VID_PKG_SIZE, timing->hactive);
379:     reg_write(base + DSI_VID_CHK_NUM, 1);
380:     reg_write(base + DSI_VID_NULL_SIZE, 0);
381: 
382:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_HINACT_TIME,
383:         DSI_VID_HSA_TIME_MASK,
384:         DSI_VID_HSA_TIME(
385:         timing->hsync_len * dsi_bits_per_pixel[format]/(8 * lane)));
386: 
387:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_HINACT_TIME,
388:         DSI_VID_HBP_TIME_MASK,
389:         DSI_VID_HBP_TIME(
390:             timing->hback_porch *
391:             dsi_bits_per_pixel[format]/(8 * lane)));
392: 
393:     reg_write(base + DSI_VID_HT_TIME,
394:         ht * dsi_bits_per_pixel[format]/(8 * lane));
395: 
396:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_VACT_LINE,
397:         DSI_VID_VSA_LINE_MASK,
398:         DSI_VID_VSA_LINE(timing->vsync_len));
399:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_VACT_LINE,
400:         DSI_VID_VACT_TIME_MASK,
401:         DSI_VID_VACT_TIME(timing->vactive));
402:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_VBLANK_LINE,
403:         DSI_VID_VBP_TIME_MASK,
404:         DSI_VID_VBP_TIME(timing->vback_porch));
405:     reg_set_bits(base + DSI_VID_VBLANK_LINE,
406:         DSI_VID_VFP_LINE_MASK,
407:         DSI_VID_VFP_LINE(timing->vfront_porch));
408: }

410: void dsi_cmd_wr(void *base, u32 dt, u32 vc, const u8 *data, u32 len)
411: {
412:     const u8 *p = data;
413:     u8 d0, d1, i;
414:     u32 val;
415:     int ret;
416:     void *CMDCFG = base + DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG;
417: 
418:     switch (dt) {
419:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P0:
420:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P0:
421:         d0 = 0; d1 = 0; i = 0;
422:         break;
423:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P1:
424:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P1:
425:     case DSI_DT_DCS_WR_P0:
426:     case DSI_DT_DCS_RD_P0:
427:         d0 = *p++; d1 = 0; i = 1;
428:         break;
429:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P2:
430:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P2:
431:     case DSI_DT_DCS_WR_P1:
432:         d0 = *p++; d1 = *p++; i = 2;
433:         break;
434:     case DSI_DT_GEN_LONG_WR:
435:     case DSI_DT_DCS_LONG_WR:
436:         d0 = len >> 0; d1 = (len >> 8) & 0xff; i = 0;
437:         break;
438:     default:
439:         d0 = 0; d1 = 0; i = 0;
440:         break;
441:     }
442: 
443:     switch (dt) {
444:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P0:
445:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SW_0P);
446:         break;
447:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P1:
448:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SW_1P);
449:         break;
450:     case DSI_DT_GEN_WR_P2:
451:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SW_2P);
452:         break;
453:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P0:
454:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SR_0P);
455:         break;
456:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P1:
457:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SR_1P);
458:         break;
459:     case DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P2:
460:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_SR_2P);
461:         break;
462:     case DSI_DT_GEN_LONG_WR:
463:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_GEN_LW);
464:         break;
465:     case DSI_DT_DCS_WR_P0:
466:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_SW_0P);
467:         break;
468:     case DSI_DT_DCS_WR_P1:
469:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_SW_1P);
470:         break;
471:     case DSI_DT_DCS_RD_P0:
472:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_SR_0P);
473:         break;
474:     case DSI_DT_DCS_LONG_WR:
475:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_DCS_LW);
476:         break;
477:     }
478: 
479:     if (dt == DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P0 || dt == DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P1 ||
480:         dt == DSI_DT_GEN_RD_P2 || dt == DSI_DT_DCS_RD_P0) {
481:         reg_set_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_ACK_REQ_EN);
482:         reg_set_bit(base + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_BTA_EN);
483:     } else {
484:         reg_clr_bit(CMDCFG, DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG_ACK_REQ_EN);
485:         reg_clr_bit(base + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_BTA_EN);
486:     }
487: 
488:     for (; i < len; i += 4)
489:         reg_write(base + DSI_GEN_PD_CFG,
490:             (*(p + i + 3) << 24) | (*(p + i + 2) << 16) |
491:             (*(p + i + 1) <<  8) | (*(p + i + 0) << 0));
492: 
493:     ret = readl_poll_timeout(base + DSI_PHY_STA,
494:             val, val & DSI_PHY_STA_STOP_STATE_0,
495:             DSI_TIMEOUT_US);
496:     if (ret) {
497:         pr_err("Timeout during wait phy stop state 0\n");
498:         return;
499:     }
500: 
501:     reg_write(base + DSI_GEN_PH_CFG,
502:         (d1 << 16) | (d0 << 8) | (vc << 6) | dt);
503: 
504:     ret = readl_poll_timeout(base + DSI_CMD_PKG_STA,
505:             val, val & DSI_CMD_PKG_STA_PLD_W_EMPTY,
506:             DSI_TIMEOUT_US);
507:     if (ret) {
508:         pr_err("failed to write pld write fifo\n");
509:         return;
510:     }
511: 
512:     aic_udelay(10);
513: }

24: /* GTC 寄存器偏移 (来源: D13x User Manual §11.1.3 表 11-1) */
25: 
26: #define GTC_CNTCR                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0000)  /* 计数器控制 */
27: #define GTC_CNTSR                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0004)  /* 计数器状态 */
28: #define GTC_CNTVL                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0008)  /* 计数值低位 [31:0] */
29: #define GTC_CNTVH                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x000C)  /* 计数值高位 [51:32] */
30: #define GTC_CNTFID0              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0020)  /* 计数频率 ID0 = 4MHz */
31: #define GTC_CNTFID1              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0024)  /* 计数频率 ID1 = 1MHz */
32: #define GTC_CNTFID2              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0028)  /* 计数频率 ID2 = 250KHz */
33: #define GTC_CONFG                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x00C0)  /* 配置: FDIV 分频 */
34: 
35: /* GTC_CNTCR 位定义 */
36: 
37: #define GTC_CNTCR_EN             (1 << 0)   /* 计数器使能 */
38: #define GTC_CNTCR_HDBG           (1 << 1)   /* 调试时保持 */
39: 
40: /* GTC 中断号: GTC 通过 CLIC 直接产生中断，IRQ 号取决于硬件连线
41:  * luban-lite 使用 CORET (IRQ 7) 作为系统 tick，GTC 仅用于使能计数
42:  * NuttX arch_alarm 模型需要一个 IRQ，使用 CORET_IRQn (7) 或
43:  * 通过 oneshot 软件比较实现。此处使用 CORET_IRQn 作为中断源。
44:  */
45: 
46: #define D13X_IRQ_GTC             7   /* CORET_IRQn, 与 luban-lite 一致 */
47: 
48: /* GTC 时钟频率: 基频 4MHz (D13x User Manual §11.1.1)
49:  * PCLK 可选 12/24/48/60 MHz，GTC 内部分频到 4MHz 基频
50:  * luban-lite system.c 中: *(volatile uint32_t *)GTC_BASE = 0x0001 (使能)
51:  * 计数频率由 GTC_CONFG 的 FDIV 字段控制
52:  */
53: 
54: #define GTC_BASE_FREQ            4000000    /* 4MHz 基频 */

76:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_current
77:  *
78:  * Description:
79:  *   Get the current timer value (clkcnt_t API)
80:  *
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: static clkcnt_t d13x_oneshot_current(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
84: {
85:   /* 读取 64-bit 计数值: 先读高 32 位，再读低 32 位，再读高 32 位
86:    * 如果高 32 位变化了，说明发生了进位，需要重读

94:       low   = getreg32(GTC_CNTVL);
95:       high2 = getreg32(GTC_CNTVH);
96:     }
97:   while (high1 != high2);
98: 
99:   return (clkcnt_t)(((uint64_t)high1 << 32) | low);
100: }

103:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_start
104:  *
105:  * Description:

114:   uint32_t cmp = now_lo + (uint32_t)delay;

117: }

120:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_start_absolute
121:  *
122:  * Description:

124:  *
125:  ****************************************************************************/
126: 
127: static void d13x_oneshot_start_absolute(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,

131: }

134:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_cancel
135:  *
136:  * Description:
137:  *   Cancel the oneshot timer (clkcnt_t API)
138:  *
139:  ****************************************************************************/
140: 
141: static void d13x_oneshot_cancel(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
142: {

144:   putreg32(0xFFFFFFFF, GTC_CNTVL);
145: }

169: {

172:   /* 调用上层回调 */

174:   if (lower->callback)

177:     }

9.1. 配置触摸屏¶

356:

luban-lite 可以支持两种触摸屏：

357:
    358:

  • 电容屏：CTP；

    • 359:

  • 电阻屏：RTP；

    • 360:
361:
362:

9.1.1. 配置 CTP¶

363:
364:

9.1.1.1. 配置¶

365:

CTP 配置部分，以 D211BBV-DEMO-V2-0 配置 GT911 为例：

366:
    367:

  • 数据通道采用 i2c3；

    • 368:

  • RST 引脚使用 PA8；

    • 369:

  • INT 引脚使用 PA9；

    • 370:
371:

通过 scons --menuconfig 命令，进入配置页面，完成如下配置：

372: 
Board options  --->
373:     [*] Using I2c3
374:         I2c3 Parameter  --->
375:             I2c3 Master && Slave  (Master)
376: Rt-Thread options  --->
377:     RT-Thread Components  --->
378:         Device Drivers  --->
379:             [*] Using Touch device drivers
380:             [*]   touch irq use pin irq
381: Drivers options  --->
382:     Peripheral  --->
383:         Touch Panel Support  --->
384:             Gt911 touch panel options  --->
385:                 [*] Using touch panel gt911
386:                 (i2c3) gt911 using i2c channel index    # 数据通道
387:                 (PA.8) gt911 reset pin                  # 复位引脚
388:                 (PA.9) gt911 irq pin                    # 中断引脚
389:     Drivers examples  --->
390:         [*] Enable touch panel driver test command      # test_gt911 测试程序
391:
392:
393:
394:
395:

396:
397:

9.1.1.2.1. 使用LVGL¶

398:

使用默认项目的 test_lvgl 程序验证 CTP 的功能，系统正常启动后，即可在触屏上点触、滑动。

399:
400:
401:

9.1.1.2.2. 使用 test_gt911¶

402:

若使用默认项目配置，可以使用如下配置取消 test_lvgl :

403: 
Application options  --->
404:     [ ] ArtInChip lvgl demo
405:
406:
407:
408:

注意

409:

测试程序运行之前，请务必保证没有 GUI 应用程序打开 gt911 设备。

410:
411:

1: # LCD 驱动
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/LCD_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: ## 一、概述
6: 
7: 对于分辨率要求不高的设备，为了节省内存，通常会采用 Universal mode（SPI/I2C/UART）类型接口的屏幕。在这种情况下，需要适配的主要是 LCD 驱动程序（LCD driver）。
8: 
9: ## 二、openvela LCD 接口
10: 
11: openvela LCD 框架对上层用户提供了标准的 VFS 文件操作接口，用户可以通过以下方式操作 `/dev/lcd0` 设备：
12: 
13: - `open`：打开 LCD 设备。
14: - `ioctl`：执行 LCD 控制命令。
15: - `close`：关闭 LCD 设备。
16: 
17: 通过这些接口，用户可以实现图形绘制和 LCD 的控制操作。
18: 
19: ### 1、驱动层接口
20: 
21: 在驱动层，openvela LCD 框架提供了以下三个函数，驱动开发者需要实现这些接口以适配具体的 LCD 硬件：
22: 
23: ```C
24: #ifdef CONFIG_LCD
25: struct lcd_dev_s; /* Forward reference */
26: 
27: int board_lcd_initialize(void);
28: FAR struct lcd_dev_s *board_lcd_getdev(int lcddev);
29: void board_lcd_uninitialize(void);
30: #endif
31: ```
32: 
33: 1. `board_lcd_initialize`
34: 
35:     用于初始化 LCD 芯片，包括 SPI 初始化、LCD 寄存器配置等硬件相关操作。
36: 
37: 2. `board_lcd_uninitialize`
38: 
39:     用于销毁 LCD 相关资源，例如关闭电源、释放内存等。
40: 
41: 3. `board_lcd_getdev`
42: 
43:     获取 LCD 设备实例，并实现 `struct lcd_dev_s` 定义的一系列方法。该函数是 LCD 驱动的核心，开发者需要实现 `struct lcd_dev_s` 中定义的所有方法。
44:

# LCD 驱动

\[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/LCD_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、概述

对于分辨率要求不高的设备，为了节省内存，通常会采用 Universal mode（SPI/I2C/UART）类型接口的屏幕。在这种情况下，需要适配的主要是 LCD 驱动程序（LCD driver）。

## 二、openvela LCD 接口

openvela LCD 框架对上层用户提供了标准的 VFS 文件操作接口，用户可以通过以下方式操作 `/dev/lcd0` 设备：

- `open`：打开 LCD 设备。
- `ioctl`：执行 LCD 控制命令。
- `close`：关闭 LCD 设备。

通过这些接口，用户可以实现图形绘制和 LCD 的控制操作。

The documentation specifies this runs in AppBringup task context where blocking calls are permitted, and the code correctly performs I2C init, touch init, and FB init here. `board_early_initialize()` is correctly left empty (no blocking allowed at that stage). `board_app_initialize()` is correctly a no-op stub. The boot sequence order (early -> late -> app) matches the documented flow. |
| 2 | Driver registration order | **PASS** | `zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md` (lines 493-501), `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/kernel/boot_process.md` (lines 13-33) | The driver registration order in `artinchip_bringup()` is: I2C -> Touch -> Framebuffer. This is correct because: (1) I2C must be initialized before touch (GT911 depends on I2C bus); (2) Framebuffer/DISPLAY is independent and registered last. This matches the documented pattern where `board_late_initialize()` handles driver init. Per `driver-troubleshooting-guide.md`, dependencies are correctly ordered. |
| 3 | I2C bus initialization sequence | **PASS** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_master_guide.md` (lines 108-119, 169-218) | The I2C driver correctly implements the documented pattern: (1) Private struct with `i2c_master_s` as first member for safe casting; (2) `d13x_i2cbus_initialize()` function returns `struct i2c_master_s *`; (3) Clock enable, controller config, and mutex init are all present; (4) `d13x_i2c_transfer()` implements the required `transfer` callback; (5) `d13x_i2c_setup()`/`d13x_i2c_shutdown()` implement enable/disable. Board code calls `d13x_i2cbus_initialize(0)` and optionally `i2c_register()` -- matching the documented board-layer pattern exactly. |
| 4 | Input device registration | **PASS** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/graphics/Input_Driver_Guide.md` (lines 183-248) | The GT911 touch driver correctly uses the NuttX `gt9xx_register()` API (from `nuttx/include/nuttx/input/gt9xx.h`), which registers at `/dev/input0`. The board-level callbacks (`gt911_irq_attach`, `gt911_irq_enable`, `gt911_set_power`) correctly implement the `struct gt9xx_board_s` interface. The documentation specifies the upper/lower half model -- the code correctly delegates to `gt9xx_register()` (upper half) and provides board callbacks (lower half). **However**, per `Input_Driver_Guide.md` line 197, ISR code should NOT call functions that may sleep, and should use work queues instead. The current ISR wrapper (`gt911_isr_wrapper`) directly calls the gt9xx ISR which may read I2C (sleeping operation). This is a **WARNING** -- the gt9xx upper-half driver itself may handle this internally via work queues. |
| 5 | Video/framebuffer device registration | **PASS** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/graphics/Framebuffer_Driver.md` (lines 105-124, 307-333) | The FB driver correctly implements all three required interfaces: (1) `up_fbinitialize(0)` -- allocates framebuffer memory, initializes vtable; (2) `up_fbgetvplane(0, 0)` -- returns the vtable; (3) `up_fbuninitialize(0)` -- frees resources. The `fb_vtable_s` correctly implements `getvideoinfo`, `getplaneinfo`, `setpower`, `getpower`, and `pandisplay`. Board code calls `up_fbinitialize(0)` then `fb_register(0, 0)` matching the documented registration pattern. The `fb_register()` source code in the doc shows it calls `up_fbinitialize()` internally, so calling it in `artinchip_bringup()` before `fb_register()` means **`up_fbinitialize` is called twice** -- once explicitly and once by `fb_register()`. The double-init is benign because `fbi->initialized` is checked, but it is **wasteful and confusing**. |
| 6 | LVGL initialization and integration | **N/A** | (no LVGL code in D13x port) | **No LVGL integration exists in the D13x port.** The `refconfig` files reference `CONFIG_GRAPHICS_LVGL=y` and `CONFIG_LV_USE_NUTTX=y` for other platforms, but no LVGL init code, no `lv_init()`, no `lv_port_disp_init()`, no `lv_port_indev_init()` exist in the D13x board code. This is not a bug per se (LVGL may not be needed for the current deliverable), but it means the touch and display drivers cannot be validated through LVGL UI. **Not a pass/fail issue -- item is not yet implemented.** |
| 7 | Error handling in initialization | **WARNING** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/driver/driver-troubleshooting-guide.md` (lines 9-49), `zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md` | **Multiple issues found:** (a) In `artinchip_bringup()`, I2C init failure does NOT block subsequent init (FB still initializes) -- this is acceptable for graceful degradation. (b) However, in `d13x_i2c_bus_initialize()`, if I2C0 succeeds but I2C1 fails, the function returns `-ENODEV` immediately, **abandoning I2C2 initialization entirely**. This is inconsistent: I2C0 failure is logged but I2C1 failure aborts. (c) The error display uses `UART_DBG_PUTCHAR('0' - ret)` which is **incorrect** for negative error codes -- e.g., `-ENODEV` (19) would print `'0' - 19 = ')'` (ASCII 41), not a meaningful digit. The arithmetic is wrong; it should be `'0' + (-ret)` or `'0' + abs(ret)`. (d) `d13x_touch_gt911_initialize()` continues to call `gt9xx_register()` even after `gt911_write_config()` fails (line 508: comment says "继续注册驱动, 使用默认配置") -- this is acceptable but should be explicitly documented as intentional. (e) Per `driver-troubleshooting-guide.md`, blocking operations should not be in init paths -- the `up_mdelay()` calls in `gt911_hw_reset()` (total ~67ms) block the bringup thread. |
| 8 | Resource cleanup on errors | **WARNING** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/graphics/Framebuffer_Driver.md` (lines 99-102) | **Partial issue:** (a) In `up_fbinitialize()`, when `CONFIG_D13X_DISPLAY` is enabled and DSI/panel/DE init fails, the code correctly jumps to `err_with_fbmem` to free `fb_mem` and reset state. This matches the documented cleanup pattern. (b) However, when DSI init fails, the panel and DE are not attempted but their clocks remain enabled (set in `d13x_clock_init()`). There is no cleanup of display clocks on error. (c) In `d13x_i2c_bus_initialize()`, when I2C initialization fails, the mutex is never initialized (init happens at line 513, after enable), so there is no mutex to clean up -- but the I2C controller remains enabled with clocks running. No shutdown on error. (d) `artinchip_bringup()` does NOT call `d13x_i2c_bus_initialize()` return value to clean up partially-initialized buses. |
| 9 | GPIO export/unexport patterns | **PASS** (partial) | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/driver/peripheral_driver/gpio/gpio_driver_development_guide.md` | The D13x GPIO usage in `artinchip_touch.c` uses direct register manipulation (`getreg32`/`putreg32`) for GPIO pin configuration, which is acceptable per the documentation: "openvela 对此层级没有定义标准接口。芯片厂商或开发者需要根据具体芯片的数据手册，自行实现这部分功能" (line 155-158). The GPIO register offsets and bit fields are correctly derived from the D13x User Manual references in comments. **However**, there is no GPIO pinmux configuration for PA.8 (RST) and PA.9 (INT) in the touch code -- the `d13x_uart_pinmux_init()` only configures PA.0/PA.1 for UART and PD.18-27 for DSI. The touch GPIO pins PA.8/PA.9 may already be in GPIO mode after reset (default), but this is **not explicitly verified** -- the luban-lite reference code calls `rt_gt911_gpio_cfg()` which explicitly sets pins to GPIO input mode before the reset sequence. The NuttX port should do the same. |
| 10 | Configuration macro usage (CONFIG_*) | **PASS** | `Kconfig` file, `zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md` (lines 386-429) | The Kconfig file correctly defines: `ARCH_CHIP_D133EBS` with proper RISC-V ISA selections (`ARCH_RV32`, `ARCH_RV_ISA_M`, `ARCH_RV_ISA_A`, `ARCH_HAVE_FPU`, `ARCH_RV_ISA_C`), `ONESHOT` and `ONESHOT_COUNT` selects, and `ARCH_HAVE_DPFPU`/`ARCH_DPFPU` for double-precision FPU. The `D13X_I2C`/`D13X_I2C0`/`D13X_I2C1`/`D13X_I2C2` hierarchy with `I2C`/`I2C_DRIVER` dependencies follows NuttX conventions. `D13X_TOUCH_GT911` correctly depends on `D13X_I2C`. `VIDEO_FB` depends on `D13X_DISPLAY`. The code uses `#ifdef` guards consistently matching these Kconfig symbols. The Kconfig structure matches the documented pattern in `porting_guide.md`. |

---

**Summary**: 6/10 items passed, 3/10 warnings, 1/10 N/A (LVGL not implemented)

**Critical Issues**: None identified. All core initialization flows are structurally correct.

**Warnings**:

1. **Double `up_fbinitialize()` call** (Item 5): `artinchip_bringup()` calls `up_fbinitialize(0)` explicitly, then `fb_register(0, 0)` which calls it again internally. While guarded by `initialized` flag, this is wasteful and confusing. Recommendation: Remove the explicit `up_fbinitialize(0)` call from `artinchip_bringup()` and let `fb_register()` handle it.

2. **Error display arithmetic bug** (Item 7): `UART_DBG_PUTCHAR('0' - ret)` produces incorrect ASCII characters for negative error codes. Should be `UART_DBG_PUTCHAR('0' + (-ret) % 10)` or use a helper function.

3. **I2C bus init inconsistency** (Item 7): `d13x_i2c_bus_initialize()` returns immediately on I2C1/I2C2 failure, potentially leaving earlier buses without proper state. Should either continue to initialize remaining buses or consistently handle all failures the same way.

4. **Missing GPIO pinmux for touch pins** (Item 9): PA.8 (RST) and PA.9 (INT) are used for GT911 but no explicit pinmux configuration to GPIO function is performed. The luban-lite reference explicitly calls `hal_gpio_direction_input()` for these pins. The NuttX port relies on reset default state which may not be GPIO mode.

5. **Missing resource cleanup on error paths** (Item 8): I2C clocks remain enabled if initialization fails. Display clocks (MIPI DSI, DE, RGB) are enabled unconditionally in `d13x_clock_init()` and never disabled on error. Display subsystem resources (DSI, panel, DE) are not initialized in reverse order on error.

6. **LVGL not integrated** (Item 6): Touch and display drivers cannot be validated end-to-end without LVGL integration. Consider adding minimal LVGL init for the deliverable.

7. **Blocking delays in bringup** (Item 7): The GT911 hardware reset sequence uses `up_mdelay()` totaling ~67ms in the bringup thread. Per `driver-troubleshooting-guide.md`, this should ideally be moved to an async work queue, though for a development board this is acceptable.

348:   return rx_cnt;
349: }

351: /****************************************************************************
352:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer
353:  *
354:  * Description:
355:  *   执行 I2C 传输
356:  *
357:  ****************************************************************************/
358: 
359: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
360:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count)
361: {
362:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv = (struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *)dev;
363:   int ret = 0;
364:   int i;
365: 
366:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
367: 
368:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
369:     {
370:       struct i2c_msg_s *msg = &msgs[i];
371: 
372:       if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
373:         {
374:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_read(priv, msg);
375:         }
376:       else
377:         {
378:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_write(priv, msg);
379:         }
380: 
381:       if (ret < 0)
382:         {
383:           ierr("I2C 传输失败: %d\n", ret);
384:           break;
385:         }
386:     }
387: 
388:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
389:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : count;
390: }

397:  *
398:  ****************************************************************************/
399: 
400: static int d13x_i2c_setup(struct i2c_master_s *dev)
401: {
402:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv = (struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *)dev;
403: 
404:   if (!priv)
405:     {
406:       return -EINVAL;
407:     }

419:  *

422: static int d13x_i2c_shutdown(struct i2c_master_s *dev)
423: {
424:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv = (struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *)dev;
425: 
426:   if (!priv)
427:     {
428:       return -EINVAL;
429:     }
430: 
431:   dw_i2c_disable(priv);
432:   iinfo("I2C shutdown: 控制器已禁用\n");
433:   return OK;
434: }

439: 
440: /****************************************************************************
441:  * Name: d13x_i2cbus_initialize
442:  *
443:  * Description:
444:  *   初始化指定的 I2C 总线并返回 master 句柄
445:  *
446:  ****************************************************************************/
447: 
448: struct i2c_master_s *d13x_i2cbus_initialize(int bus)
449: {
450:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv;
451:   uint32_t reg;
452: 
453:   switch (bus)
454:     {
455: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
456:       case 0:
457:         priv = &g_i2c0_priv;
458:         break;
459: #endif
460: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
461:       case 1:
462:         priv = &g_i2c1_priv;
463:         break;
464: #endif
465: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
466:       case 2:
467:         priv = &g_i2c2_priv;
468:         break;
469: #endif
470:       default:
471:         return NULL;
472:     }
473: 
474:   /* 使能 I2C 模块时钟 */
475: 
476:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
477:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
478:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
479: 
480:   /* 禁用 I2C 以配置 */
481: 
482:   dw_i2c_disable(priv);
483: 
484:   /* 配置为主模式, Fast Mode (400kHz), 重启使能 */
485: 
486:   reg = DW_I2C_CTL_MASTER | DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS | DW_I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
487:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_CTL, reg);
488: 
489:   /* 配置 SCL 时序 (400kHz @ I2C模块时钟)
490:    * 根据 luban-lite HAL, I2C模块时钟为24MHz (I2C_DEFALT_CLOCK)
491:    * FS_SCL_HCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 8 = 22
492:    * FS_SCL_LCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 1 = 29
493:    */
494: 
495:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, 22);
496:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, 29);
497: 
498:   /* 设置 SDA 保持时间 */
499: 
500:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD, 12);
501: 
502:   /* 设置 TX/RX FIFO 阈值 */
503: 
504:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xFFFF);
505:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_MASK, 0);
506: 
507:   /* 使能 I2C */
508: 
509:   dw_i2c_enable(priv);
510: 
511:   /* 初始化互斥锁 */
512: 
513:   nxmutex_init(&priv->lock);
514: 
515:   iinfo("I2C%d 初始化完成, 基地址=0x%08X\n", bus, priv->base);
516: 
517:   return &priv->dev;
518: }

Documentation says PLL_INT1/20 = 60MHz (divisor should be 19). chip.h line 90 defines D13X_UART0_FREQ=48000000 to match the code, but board.h line 20 says BOARD_UARTCLK=60000000. The baud rate calculation uses 48MHz so UART works, but this is inconsistent with documentation and board.h. AXI/AHB (200MHz) and APB0 (100MHz) are correct. |
| 7 | Timer/Alarm configuration | **PASS** | artinchip_oneshot.c line 46: "D13X_IRQ_GTC = 7 (CORET_IRQn)"; D13x_full_specs.txt references GTC | GTC at 0x19050000, 4MHz base frequency, uses CORET_IRQn (IRQ 7). Matches luban-lite reference. Oneshot driver correctly implements NuttX arch_alarm model. |
| 8 | I2C controller configuration | **PASS** | chip.h lines 71-73: I2C0=0x19220000; artinchip_i2c.c line 118: IRQ=84 | DesignWare I2C at correct base address. Fast Mode 400kHz. Clock enable via CMU offset 0x844. I2C0/1/2 with sequential IRQs 84/85/86. |

D12x: head.S -> nx_start() directly. **Summary**: 16/18 items passed, 2 warnings

**Critical Issues**: None

**Warnings**:

1. **UART0 Clock Mismatch (Item 6)**: The UART0 module clock is configured as 48MHz in code (divisor=24 in CMU_CLK_UART0), but documentation says it should be 60MHz (PLL_INT1/20). The baud rate divisor calculation in artinchip_start.c uses D13X_UART0_FREQ=48MHz (chip.h line 90), which matches the actual clock output, so UART communication works correctly. However, board.h line 20 defines BOARD_UARTCLK=60000000, creating an internal inconsistency. If any other driver uses BOARD_UARTCLK for calculations, it will produce incorrect results. To fix: either change the UART0 clock divisor from 24 to 19 (to get 60MHz as documented), or update board.h to match the actual 48MHz.

2. **FPU Not Enabled in Startup Assembly (Item 17)**: The D13x startup code (d13x_head.S) does not enable the FPU, unlike the D12x reference which sets mstatus.FS=11 (Dirty) and clears fscsr. While NuttX handles FPU context during thread switches, the D12x approach of enabling FPU early is more defensive. Since defconfig enables CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y and CONFIG_ARCH_DPFPU=y, adding FPU enablement in head.S (matching D12x pattern) would be prudent.

**Additional Observations**:

- The D13x startup code has extensive debug character output (A/G/S/B/D/F via direct UART register writes at 0x18710000). These are useful for boot debugging but should be removed or made conditional for production builds.
- The `jal x1, __start_c` instruction (Item 13) is functionally correct. The use of x1 (ra) as the link register is standard, and since __start_c never returns, the stored return address is unused. The D12x's `la a5, nx_start; jalr a5` pattern is slightly more robust (no range limitation) but the D13x direct JAL is fine for code in the same section.
- The D13x PSRAM initialization (artinchip_start.c lines 511-616) is comprehensive, handling XSPI controller setup, LUT configuration, DLL calibration, and XIP enable. This suggests the SPL/bootloader may not always initialize PSRAM, requiring the NuttX startup to handle it.
- The D13x defers interrupt vector table setup to C code (up_irqinitialize in artinchip_irq.c) rather than doing it in assembly like D12x. This means no interrupts are handled between reset and the C entry point reaching up_irqinitialize. This is acceptable since interrupts are explicitly disabled at the start of head.S.

   - **ISSUE**: The OpenVela PHY init is MISSING the `dsi_dphy_cfg_hsfreq()` call, which configures the HS frequency settings via the DPHY test interface. This is critical for proper PHY operation. The resolution and pixel clock differ because it's a different panel (4.3" 1024x600 vs 1080x1920). These are panel-specific values, so this appears correct for the 4.3" panel.

3. **Framebuffer memory configuration**:

   - Total: 1024 * 600 * 4 * 2 = 4,915,200 bytes (~4.7MB)
   - The Framebuffer Driver doc says: ARGB888 (32bpp) = width x height x 4 bytes. The OpenVela code uses RGB32 (32bpp) which is correct.
   - The D13x has 8MB PSRAM, so ~4.7MB for framebuffer is feasible but leaves limited headroom.
   - The doc says the buffer should be allocated with `kmm_zalloc` and be `bpp * xres / 8` aligned. The OpenVela uses `kmm_memalign(64, ...)` which provides cache-line alignment - this is good.

4. **LCD reset GPIO pin number and active level**:
   - OpenVela: No LCD reset GPIO is defined. The panel init sequence uses `panel_send_dcs_cmd(0x11, NULL, 0)` (exit sleep) and `panel_send_dcs_cmd(0x29, NULL, 0)` (display on) but no hardware reset via GPIO.

- `DSI_DPI_IF_CFG` (interface format)
- `DSI_DPI_IN_FMT` (input format data type)
- `DSI_DPI_IN_POL` (polarity)
- `DSI_DPI_VC` (virtual channel)
- `DSI_VID_MODE_CFG` (video mode type, LP enable bits)
- `DSI_VID_PKG_SIZE` (packet size)
- `DSI_VID_HINACT_TIME` (HSA, HBP)
- `DSI_VID_HT_TIME` (total horizontal time)
- `DSI_VID_VBLANK_LINE` (VBP, VFP)
- `DSI_VID_VACT_LINE` (VSA, VACT)

None of these video mode registers are configured in the OpenVela code. This is a CRITICAL issue - the DSI will not properly stream video data without these settings.

310:  * Name: d13x_dsi_init
311:  *
312:  * Description:
313:  *   初始化 MIPI DSI 控制器
314:  *
315:  ****************************************************************************/
316: 
317: int d13x_dsi_init(uint32_t pixel_clock)
318: {
319:   int ret;
320: 
321:   iinfo("Initializing MIPI DSI...\n");
322: 
323:   /* 使能控制器 */
324: 
325:   d13x_dsi_enable();
326: 
327:   /* 配置时钟分频
328:    * 根据 luban-lite drv_dsi.c aic_dsi_attach_panel():
329:    * sclk_rate = pixel_clock * format_div / lane_num
330:    * RGB888 format_div = 24, lane_num = 4
331:    * sclk_rate = 51200000 * 24 / 4 = 307200000 (307.2MHz)
332:    * LP 分频器 = sclk_rate / 8 / LP_RATE
333:    */
334: 
335:   uint32_t format_div = 24;  /* RGB888 */
336:   uint32_t lane_num = 4;
337:   uint32_t sclk_rate = pixel_clock * format_div / lane_num;
338:   uint32_t div = sclk_rate / 8 / DSI_LP_RATE;
339:   uint32_t val = dsi_read(DSI_CLK_CFG);
340:   val &= ~(DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV_MASK);
341:   val |= DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV(div);
342:   dsi_write(DSI_CLK_CFG, val);
343: 
344:   iinfo("DSI clock: pixel=%dHz, sclk=%dHz, div=%d\n",
345:         pixel_clock, sclk_rate, div);
346: 
347:   /* 配置包 */
348: 
349:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_CRC_RX_EN | DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_ECC_RX_EN);
350: 
351:   /* 配置 LP 传输时间 */
352: 
353:   dsi_write(DSI_DPI_LPTX_TIME, (64 << 16) | 64);
354: 
355:   /* 配置超时 */
356: 
357:   dsi_write(DSI_TO_CNT_CFG, 0);
358: 
359:   /* 配置命令模式 */
360: 
361:   val = BIT(24) | BIT(19) | BIT(18) | BIT(17) | BIT(16) |
362:         BIT(14) | BIT(13) | BIT(12) | BIT(11) | BIT(10) | BIT(9) | BIT(8);
363:   dsi_write(DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG, val);
364: 
365:   /* 配置通道 */
366: 
367:   dsi_write(DSI_LANE_CFG, 0x3210);
368: 
369:   /* 初始化 PHY */
370: 
371:   ret = d13x_dsi_phy_init(pixel_clock);
372:   if (ret < 0)
373:     {
374:       ierr("DSI PHY init failed: %d\n", ret);
375:       return ret;
376:     }
377: 
378:   /* 使能高速时钟 */
379: 
380:   ret = d13x_dsi_hs_clk_enable(true);
381:   if (ret < 0)
382:     {
383:       ierr("DSI HS clock enable failed: %d\n", ret);
384:       return ret;
385:     }
386: 
387:   iinfo("MIPI DSI initialized, pixel clock=%d Hz\n", pixel_clock);
388:   return OK;
389: }

151: /****************************************************************************

153:  *
154:  * 1. RST=LOW, 等待 10ms
155:  * 2. INT=LOW
156:  * 3. 等待 2ms
157:  * 4. RST=HIGH
158:  * 5. 等待 5ms
159:  * 6. RST 切换为输入
160:  * 7. INT=LOW, 等待 50ms
161:  * 8. INT 切换为输入

164: static void gt911_hw_reset(void)
165: {
166:   /* 1. RST=LOW */
167: 
168:   gpio_set_output(GT911_RST_PIN);
169:   gpio_write(GT911_RST_PIN, false);
170:   up_mdelay(10);
171: 
172:   /* 2-3. INT=LOW, 等待 2ms */
173: 
174:   gpio_set_output(GT911_INT_PIN);
175:   gpio_write(GT911_INT_PIN, false);
176:   up_mdelay(2);
177: 
178:   /* 4-5. RST=HIGH, 等待 5ms */
179: 
180:   gpio_write(GT911_RST_PIN, true);
181:   up_mdelay(5);
182: 
183:   /* 6. RST 切换为输入 */
184:

186: 
187:   /* 7-8. INT=LOW, 等待 50ms 后切换为输入 */
188: 
189:   gpio_write(GT911_INT_PIN, false);
190:   up_mdelay(50);
191:   gpio_set_input(GT911_INT_PIN);

205: static int gt911_isr_wrapper(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
206: {
207:   uint32_t group = GPIO_GROUP(GT911_INT_PIN);
208:   uint32_t pin = GPIO_PIN(GT911_INT_PIN);
209: 
210:   /* 清除 PA9 GPIO 中断状态 (写1清除) */
211: 
212:   putreg32((1 << pin), D13X_GPIO_IRQ_STAT(group));
213: 
214:   /* 调用原始 gt9xx ISR */
215: 
216:   if (g_gt911_isr)

218:       return g_gt911_isr(irq, context, g_gt911_arg);
219:     }

224: static int gt911_irq_attach(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state,
225:                             xcpt_t isr, FAR void *arg)
226: {
227:   uint32_t group = GPIO_GROUP(GT911_INT_PIN);
228:   uint32_t pin = GPIO_PIN(GT911_INT_PIN);
229:   uint32_t val;
230: 
231:   (void)state;
232: 
233:   /* 保存中断处理函数 */
234: 
235:   g_gt911_isr = isr;
236:   g_gt911_arg = arg;
237: 
238:   /* 配置 PA9 为 GPIO 通用功能 (PIN_FUN=1) */
239: 
240:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_PIN_CFG(group, pin));
241:   val &= ~(PIN_CFG_FUN_MASK << PIN_CFG_FUN_SHIFT);
242:   val |= (GPIO_FUN_GEN << PIN_CFG_FUN_SHIFT);
243:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_PIN_CFG(group, pin));
244: 
245:   /* 配置 PA9 为输入 */
246: 
247:   gpio_set_input(GT911_INT_PIN);
248: 
249:   /* 配置中断模式: 下降沿触发 (GT911 中断低电平有效) */
250: 
251:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_PIN_CFG(group, pin));
252:   val &= ~(0x7 << PIN_CFG_IRQ_MODE_SHIFT);
253:   val |= (GPIO_IRQ_FALLING << PIN_CFG_IRQ_MODE_SHIFT);
254:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_PIN_CFG(group, pin));
255: 
256:   /* 注册 GPIO 中断处理函数 (使用包装器以清除中断状态) */
257: 
258:   irq_attach(D13X_IRQ_GPIO, gt911_isr_wrapper, arg);

362: /****************************************************************************
363:  * GT911 I2C 辅助函数
364:  ****************************************************************************/
365: 
366: static int gt911_i2c_write_reg(struct i2c_master_s *i2c, uint16_t reg,
367:                                const uint8_t *data, uint8_t len)
368: {
369:   uint8_t buf[2 + 64];  /* 寄存器地址(2字节) + 数据 */
370:   struct i2c_msg_s msg;
371:   int ret;
372: 
373:   if (len > 64)
374:     {
375:       return -EINVAL;
376:     }
377: 
378:   /* 构建写缓冲区: 寄存器地址(MSB first) + 数据 */
379: 
380:   buf[0] = (reg >> 8) & 0xff;
381:   buf[1] = reg & 0xff;
382:   memcpy(&buf[2], data, len);
383: 
384:   msg.frequency = 400000;
385:   msg.addr = GT911_I2C_ADDR;
386:   msg.flags = 0;
387:   msg.buffer = buf;
388:   msg.length = len + 2;
389: 
390:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
391:   return (ret == 1) ? OK : -EIO;
392: }

394: /****************************************************************************
395:  * gt911_write_config - 写入GT911配置表
396:  *
397:  * 描述:
398:  *   向GT911写入配置参数（分辨率、触摸点数、中断模式等）
399:  *   来源: luban-lite gt911.c gt911_control()
400:  *
401:  ****************************************************************************/
402: 
403: static int gt911_write_config(struct i2c_master_s *i2c)
404: {
405:   /* GT911 配置寄存器: 0x8047-0x80FE (184字节), 0x80FF (校验和), 0x8100 (版本/更新) */
406: 
407:   #define GT911_CONFIG_SIZE    184   /* 0x8047-0x80FE */
408:   #define GT911_CHECKSUM_REG   0x80FF
409:   #define GT911_UPDATE_REG     0x8100
410: 
411:   uint8_t buf[2 + GT911_CONFIG_SIZE + 2];  /* 寄存器地址 + 配置 + 校验和 + 更新标志 */
412:   uint8_t checksum = 0;
413:   int i;
414:   int ret;
415: 
416:   /* 构建写缓冲区: 寄存器地址(0x8047) + 配置数据 + 校验和 + 更新标志 */
417: 
418:   buf[0] = 0x80;  /* 配置寄存器地址高字节 */
419:   buf[1] = 0x47;  /* 配置寄存器地址低字节 */
420: 
421:   /* 复制前 184 字节配置数据 */
422: 
423:   memcpy(&buf[2], gt911_config_table, GT911_CONFIG_SIZE);
424: 
425:   /* 计算校验和: 配置数据字节求和, 取反加1 */
426: 
427:   for (i = 0; i < GT911_CONFIG_SIZE; i++)
428:     {
429:       checksum += gt911_config_table[i];
430:     }
431: 
432:   checksum = (~checksum) + 1;
433:   buf[2 + GT911_CONFIG_SIZE] = checksum;      /* 0x80FF: 校验和 */
434:   buf[2 + GT911_CONFIG_SIZE + 1] = 0x01;      /* 0x8100: 写入标志 */
435: 
436:   /* 写入配置 */
437: 
438:   struct i2c_msg_s msg;
439:   msg.frequency = 400000;
440:   msg.addr = GT911_I2C_ADDR;
441:   msg.flags = 0;
442:   msg.buffer = buf;
443:   msg.length = sizeof(buf);
444: 
445:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
446:   if (ret != 1)
447:     {
448:       ierr("GT911 配置写入失败\n");
449:       return -EIO;
450:     }
451: 
452:   /* 写入配置更新标志 (寄存器0x8100 = 1) */
453: 
454:   uint8_t update_buf[3] = { 0x81, 0x00, 0x01 };
455:   msg.buffer = update_buf;
456:   msg.length = 3;
457:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
458:   if (ret != 1)
459:     {
460:       ierr("GT911 配置更新标志写入失败\n");
461:       return -EIO;
462:     }
463: 
464:   /* 等待配置生效 */
465: 
466:   up_mdelay(50);
467: 
468:   iinfo("GT911 配置写入完成\n");
469:   return OK;

80: #define WDOG_IRQ_STA        (D13X_WDT_BASE + 0x00C)

85: #define XSPI_CLK            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x004)
86: #define XSPI_TCR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x008)

93: #define XSPI_CS0_DCTL       (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x014)
94: #define XSPI_CS1_DCTL       (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x01C)
95: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x070)
96: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x074)
97: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x078)
98: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x07C)
99: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x080)
100: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x084)
101: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x088)

103: #define XSPI_TDR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x200)
104: #define XSPI_RDR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x300)
105: #define XSPI_LUTN(n)        (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x100 + 0x4 * (n))
106: 
107: /* XSPI_CTL 位域 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h) */
108: 
109: #define CTL_XSPI_EN         (1 << 0)
110: #define CTL_XIP_EN          (1 << 2)
111: #define CTL_AXI_BURST       (1 << 3)
112: #define CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT 4
113: #define CTL_XSPI_MODE_MASK  (0x3 << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT)
114: #define CTL_PARALLEL_MODE   (1 << 6)
115: #define CTL_TIMEOUT_EN      (1 << 7)

131:

133: #define FCR_TF_RST           (1 << 31)

135: /* LUT 指令 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h) */
136: 
137: #define LUT_STOP             0x0
138: #define LUT_CMD              0x1
139: #define LUT_CMD_EX           0x2
140: #define LUT_ADDR             0x3
141: #define LUT_WRITE            0x4
142: #define LUT_READ             0x5
143: #define LUT_CMD_DDR          0x11
144: #define LUT_ADDR_DDR         0x13
145: #define LUT_WRITE_DDR        0x14
146: #define LUT_READ_DDR         0x15

153: #define LUT_IO_4             0x2

157:

159: #define LUT_UNLOCK           0x2

161: /* LUT 条目编码宏 */
162: 
163: #define LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l) \
164:   (((ins_h) << 26) | ((io_h) << 24) | ((op_h) << 16) | \
165:    ((ins_l) << 10) | ((io_l) << 8) | (op_l))
166: 
167: /* BSS 段符号 */
168: 
169: extern uint32_t _sbss[];
170: extern uint32_t _ebss[];
171: extern uint32_t _sdata[];

176:  * Private Functions
177:  ****************************************************************************/
178: 
179: static inline void xspi_wait_idle(void)
180: {
181:   while (getreg32(XSPI_STAS) & STAS_BUSY);
182: }
183: 
184: static void d13x_clock_init(void)
185: {
186:   uint32_t reg;
187: 
188:   /* 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 */
189: 
190:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
191:   reg |= (1 << 1);
192:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);
193: 
194:   /* 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_COM);
197:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);
198:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_COM);
199: 
200:   /* 3. 使能 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49) */
201: 
202:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
203:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
204:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
205:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
206: 
207:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
208: 
209:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
210:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
211:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
212:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
213:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
214:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
215: 
216:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
217: 
218:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
219: 
220:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
221: 
222:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
223: 
224:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
225: 
226:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
227: 
228:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 (MOD_RSTN bit13 + MOD_BUS_EN bit12 + MOD_CLK_EN bit8) */
229: 
230:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
231:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
232:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
233: 
234:   /* 9. UART0 = 48MHz (PLL_INT1/(24+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
235: 
236:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 24,
237:            CMU_CLK_UART0);
238: 
239:   /* 10. 显示时钟使能 (来源: luban-lite aic_board_sysclk_init)
240:    *     - MIPI DSI: CMU_CLK_MIPIDSI (0x0888)
241:    *     - Display Engine: CMU_CLK_DE (0x08C0)
242:    *     - RGB/TCON: CMU_CLK_RGB (0x0880)
243:    *     位域: MOD_RSTN(bit13) + MOD_BUS_EN(bit12) + MOD_CLK_EN(bit8)
244:    */
245: 
246:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_MIPIDSI);
247:   reg |= DISP_CLK_MOD_RSTN | DISP_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | DISP_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN;
248:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_MIPIDSI);
249: 
250:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_DE);
251:   reg |= DISP_CLK_MOD_RSTN | DISP_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | DISP_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN;
252:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_DE);
253: 
254:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_RGB);
255:   reg |= DISP_CLK_MOD_RSTN | DISP_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | DISP_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN;
256:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_RGB);
257: }
258: 
259: /****************************************************************************
260:  * UART0 引脚配置 (PA0=UART0_TX, PA1=UART0_RX)
261:  * 来源: D13x ic/pinmux/index.html + luban-lite target/d13x/demo88-nor/pinmux.c
262:  ****************************************************************************/
263: 
264: static void d13x_uart_pinmux_init(void)
265: {
266:   uint32_t val;
267: 
268:   /* PA.0 (UART0_TX): GPIO_BASE + 0*0x100 + 0*0x4 + 0x80 = 0x18700080 */
269: 
270:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
271:                  0 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
272:   val &= ~(GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT);
273:   val |= (UART0_PIN_FUN & GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK) << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT;
274:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
275:            0 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
276: 
277:   /* PA.1 (UART0_RX): GPIO_BASE + 0*0x100 + 1*0x4 + 0x80 = 0x18700084 */
278: 
279:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
280:                  1 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
281:   val &= ~(GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT);
282:   val |= (UART0_PIN_FUN & GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK) << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT;
283:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
284:            1 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
285: }
286: 
287: /****************************************************************************
288:  * MIPI DSI 引脚配置 (PD.18-PD.27, function=4)
289:  * 来源: luban-lite target/d13x/demo88-nor/pinmux.c
290:  ****************************************************************************/
291: 
292: static void d13x_dsi_pinmux_init(void)
293: {
294:   uint32_t val;
295:   uint32_t pin;
296: 
297:   /* PD.18 - PD.27: MIPI DSI 数据/时钟引脚

318: {

329:    * sclk_rate = pixel_clock * format_div / lane_num
330:    * RGB888 format_div = 24, lane_num = 4

332:    * LP 分频器 = sclk_rate / 8 / LP_RATE

338:   uint32_t div = sclk_rate / 8 / DSI_LP_RATE;
339:   uint32_t val = dsi_read(DSI_CLK_CFG);
340:   val &= ~(DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV_MASK);

342:   dsi_write(DSI_CLK_CFG, val);
343:

346: 
347:   /* 配置包 */

### Pack Command
```bash

### Pack Script Location
- **Path**: `openvela/vendor/artinchip/pack/pack.sh`

### Pack Process
The pack script performs:
1. Auto-detect board and chip from `.config`
2. Sync board-specific pack config
3. Convert ELF to BIN (`nuttx.bin`)
4. Generate file system images (FATFS, LittleFS)
5. Generate private resources (PBP, Partition)
6. Generate final `.img` image

### Pack Output Files
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `nuttx.bin` | Binary firmware |
| `nuttx.elf` | ELF with debug info |
| `rodata.fatfs` | Read-only data filesystem |
| `data.lfs` | LittleFS data filesystem |
| `pbp_cfg.bin` | Private resources |
| `d13x_hengshan-pi_v1.0.0.img` | **Final flashable image** |

### Manual Pack with Parameters

# Specify board and chip
./pack.sh hengshan-pi d13x
```

## Burning (烧录)

### Prerequisites
- NuttX compiled successfully (`nuttx` ELF + `nuttx.bin`)
- AiBurn installed (`~/.wine/drive_c/ArtInChip/AiBurn/AiBurn.exe`)

### Enter Burning Mode
| Method | Operation |
|--------|-----------|
| Empty chip | Auto-enter on power on |
| BOOT button | Hold BOOT + Insert Type-C |
| U-Boot console | Press Ctrl+C, enter `aicupg usb 0` |
| Linux console | Enter `aicupg` |
| ADB | AiBurn auto-detect |

### Check Device
```bash
lsusb | grep -i artinchip
# Should show: Bus 001 Device 008: ID 33c3:6677 Artinchip Artinchip Device
```

### Launch AiBurn
```bash
wine ~/.wine/drive_c/ArtInChip/AiBurn/AiBurn.exe
```

### Burning Steps
1. Select "烧写镜像" tab
2. Click folder icon, select `.img` file
3. Confirm connection is USB
4. Click "开始" to burn
5. Wait for completion, board auto-reboots

### Image Format
```
Offset 0x00: "AIC.FW" (6 bytes magic)
Offset 0x06: Reserved (2 bytes)
Offset 0x08: "d13x" (platform name)
Offset 0x40: "hengshan-pi" (product name)
Offset 0x80: "1.0.0" (version)
Offset 0xC0: "spi-nor" (storage type)
```

### Partition Layout
| Partition | Size | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| spl | 512KB | Bootloader |
| env | 128KB | Environment variables |
| env_r | 128KB | Environment backup |
| userid | 256KB | User ID |
| os | 3MB | OS firmware |
| rodata | 10MB | Read-only data |
| data | 1MB | Writable data |

## Common Build Issues & Solutions

### 1. Toolchain Not Found
```bash

# If not, set PATH
export PATH=/path/to/riscv/toolchain/bin:$PATH
```

### 2. UnionFS Mount Error
```bash
# Install unionfs-fuse
sudo apt-get install unionfs-fuse

# Or use in-tree build without -m flag
./build.sh d13x-hengshan-pi:nsh
```

### 3. kconfig-conf Not Found
The build script auto-installs kconfig tools to `prebuilts/kconfig-frontends/`. If it fails:
```bash
cd /home/lladlam/OpenVela/openvela/prebuilts/kconfig-frontends
./configure --prefix=$(pwd) --enable-mconf --disable-nconf --disable-gconf --disable-qconf
make install
```

# Always save config after menuconfig
./build.sh d13x-hengshan-pi:nsh savedefconfig
```

    • 3.1. Boot 介绍

      • 3.1. Boot 介绍¶

      tinySPL 是 Baremetal 中的启动引导程序(Bootloader)，其功能包含了加载启动应用程序、

      其中 PBP(PreBootProgram) 主要做 DRAM 初始化工作，tinySPL 负责进行启动和升级。

      tinySPL 是基于 Baremetal 的 HAL 构建的裸机(Baremetal) 程序，其软件架构如下图所示。

      以简化 Boot 对不同板子的支持。

      新配置一个板子后，需要为该方案编译生成一个 bootloader.bin 。

      在 Baremetal SDK 中，Boot 程序可以当作一个独立的裸机项目进行编译，与 SDK 中的其他方案编译方法相同。

      scons --apply-def d21x_demo88-nand_baremetal_bootloader_defconfig

      编译完成时，除了在 output/d21x_demo88-nand_baremetal_bootloader/images/ 下生成 elf 文件外，
还会将 bootloader.bin 复制到板级目录之中，供打包烧录镜像时使用:
      

      target/d21x/demo88-nand/pack/bootloader.bin

      编译 Boot 时，不会打包烧录镜像文件，编译应用时才会打包烧录镜像。
      

      在编译应用时，如果 bootloader.bin 已经存在，并且分区等配置没有改变，则不需要重新编译 Bootloader。

    fi

PRJ_OUT=$(realpath $CUR_DIR/prebuilt)

#!/bin/bash

CUR_DIR=$(pwd)
SDK_ROOT=$(realpath $CUR_DIR/../../..)

# 1.  auto from .config or pass as parameter (e.g., demo68-nor)
BOARD_NAME=$1
if [ -z "$BOARD_NAME" ]; then
    if [ -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config ]; then
        BOARD_NAME=$(grep CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_NAME $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d '"')
    fi
fi
#  get chip model (e.g., d12x)
CHIP_NAME=$2
if [ -z "$CHIP_NAME" ]; then
    if [ -f $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config ]; then
        if grep -q "CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_D12X=y" $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config; then
            CHIP_NAME="d12x"
        else
            CHIP_NAME=$(grep -E "CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_[A-Z0-9]+" $SDK_ROOT/nuttx/.config | grep "=y" | head -n 1 | cut -d'_' -f4 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | cut -d'=' -f1)
        fi
    fi
fi

#  default fallback
BOARD_NAME=${BOARD_NAME:-demo68-nor}
CHIP_NAME=${CHIP_NAME:-d12x}

echo ">>> Packing for Board: $BOARD_NAME, Chip: $CHIP_NAME"

BOARD_DIR=$SDK_ROOT/vendor/artinchip/boards/$CHIP_NAME/$BOARD_NAME
PRJ_OUT=$(realpath $CUR_DIR/prebuilt)
TOOLDIR=$SDK_ROOT/vendor/artinchip/tools/scripts
TOOLCHAIN_DIR=${SDK_ROOT}/vendor/artinchip/toolchain/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-
OBJ_COPY=${TOOLCHAIN_DIR}objcopy
ELF_SIZE=${TOOLCHAIN_DIR}size

# 2.  sync from $BOARD_DIR/pack to $PRJ_OUT/ from boards directory

    cp -rv $BOARD_DIR/pack/* $PRJ_OUT/
fi

    $OBJ_COPY -S -O binary -R .note -R .note.gnu.build-id -R .comment $PRJ_OUT/$CHIP_NAME.elf $PRJ_OUT/nuttx.bin

    $ELF_SIZE $PRJ_OUT/$CHIP_NAME.elf
fi

python3 $TOOLDIR/makelittlefs.py --pagesize 256 --blocksize 4096 --tooldir $TOOLDIR --inputdir data/ --outfile $PRJ_OUT/data.lfs
popd > /dev/null

## Goal
